history.reason: 先按 M1 做一次真实门禁晋升验证

findings.detail: Contract, behavior-only routing config, one-shot legacy migration, read-only adapters, isolation and fail-closed tests, 531 passing tests and a 0-blocking/0-warning doctor run collectively satisfy the M1 acceptance surface.
findings.title: M1 acceptance evidence is complete and gate-clean

findings.detail: Only the CCG source commit is pushed; the harness-side candidate is uncommitted, so the verified state is not fully reproducible from version control at this revision.
findings.title: Delivery state is split: harness candidate uncommitted

findings.detail: All milestones are recorded as not_started with a null completion matrix while drift flags stale_review across M1..M6, so the ledger does not reflect the delivered M1 state.
findings.title: Plan bookkeeping lags delivered reality

findings.detail: A single Windows symlink test is skipped; acceptable for M1 but should be covered on a POSIX runner before FINAL.
findings.title: One environment-conditional skip remains

findings.detail: The prior FINAL rejection asked for a real gate promotion verification at M1; the doctor run plus routing and fail-closed suites constitute that rehearsal.
findings.title: User-requested M1 gate promotion rehearsal is satisfied

processAdjustments.statement: Require every milestone evidence bundle to cite committed shas for all repositories touched, so no checkpoint is accepted against uncommitted working-tree state.
Fold the completion-matrix update into the milestone acceptance step so a milestone can never remain not_started after an accepted review.
Label environment-conditional skips distinctly from genuine coverage gaps, and require a cross-platform run before FINAL rather than at every milestone.

latestAdvice.productManagerStatement: 你要求的「先按 M1 做一次真实门禁晋升验证」已经完成，结果通过。产品经理角色已作为第四个统一路由角色落地：它只负责路由行为、独占 provider 决定权；旧的 product-manager provider 只迁移一次随后被移除，不留双重权限；Claude、Gemini、Codex 均为只读适配器，选到未实现或不被允许的 provider 时直接失败，不会悄悄回退到其他 provider。角色隔离与直接切换测试通过，531 项测试通过、仅 1 项因 Windows 符号链接限制跳过，doctor 门禁 0 阻塞、0 警告、18 项通过。结论：M1 验收通过。需要马上收尾两件事：harness 侧改动尚未提交（目前只有 CCG 源码已推送），以及计划台账里所有里程碑仍标记为 not_started 且 M1~M6 都带过期评审标记。建议先提交并推送 harness、把 M1 标为已验收并清理过期标记，再开 M2（Harness 与 Trellis 桥接）。整体进度 15/100，健康度黄色，原因仅在交付与台账收尾，不涉及功能缺陷。
latestAdvice.recommendedNextAction: Accept M1, then immediately (1) commit and push the harness candidate and register its sha in the M1 evidence set, (2) update the completion matrix to mark M1 accepted at plan revision 11 and clear the superseded stale_review drift on M1..M6, and (3) open M2 (Harness 与 Trellis canonical bridge) with a POSIX-runner zero-skip test run and a runtime provider-failure fail-closed test added to its acceptance list.

risks.mitigation: Commit and push the harness candidate on a branch, record its sha in the M1 evidence set, then re-run doctor to confirm parity.
risks.statement: The uncommitted harness candidate means the verified M1 state is not reproducible from VCS and could drift or be lost before M2 begins.

risks.mitigation: Mark M1 accepted at plan revision 11 in the completion matrix and clear the stale_review stamps that revision 11 superseded.
risks.statement: A ledger showing not_started for a completed M1 plus stale_review across all milestones can cause duplicated work or a false FINAL promotion.

risks.mitigation: Run the identical suite on a POSIX CI runner before FINAL and attach the zero-skip result.
risks.statement: The Windows-only symlink skip may mask a platform-specific defect in artifact linking.

risks.mitigation: Add a runtime adapter-failure test asserting explicit error surfacing with no provider substitution before M2 sign-off.
risks.statement: Fail-closed behaviour is proven for configuration errors but not runtime provider failures, risking silent cross-provider fallback later.
